question: Should the default host-read document policy admit `text/vcard` now that the branch validates the entire buffer for sniffed text documents?
rationale: The implementation addresses the identifiable spoofing flaw, but admitting another local-file MIME through a capability boundary is a product security-policy choice rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Approve the default allowlist expansion
options.body: Accept `text/vcard` as a standard host-read text document after rebasing and rerunning the focused vCard and binary-tail coverage.

options.title: Keep the allowlist unchanged
options.body: Retain the current boundary and close this feature path if maintainers do not want vCards admitted by default.

recommendation.title: Approve the default allowlist expansion
